result.reason: The clause largely tracks the preferred position: the Company owns the deliverables and Company Data, HDI assigns the work product, embedded HDI IP is licensed perpetually, irrevocably, worldwide and royalty-free, and joint ownership is disclaimed. However, defining “HDI Pre-Existing IP” to include all “improvements thereto” improperly extends HDI’s ownership beyond genuinely pre-existing IP and is not limited to generic tools or know-how as permitted by the fallback. That unnecessary carve-out could capture customer-specific improvements developed under the agreement. The unrelated operational and trademark provisions are preserved, and the drafting is otherwise professional.
